purpose: HMRC Child Benefit statistics, annual release at August 2025, United Kingdom: the percentage of eligible children for whom Child Benefit is claimed, opted-out families included, by single year of age and for all ages (Table 15, May 2025 reference month); families registered, families in payment and families opted out of payment because of the High Income Child Benefit Charge; children registered; children in payment and children in opted-out families by single year of age. Consumed by the child_benefit_take_up stage, which draws family claims to the claim rates by age and opt-outs to the opted-out share of registered families, and reports the frame's families and children in payment beside the published ones (microcosm#1063).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
